purpose: Check project-adapted Ragas source support against three externally human-labelled SNLI hypotheses. NOT startup or investment evaluation, not training.
selection: First3nonambiguous test rows among first6; no model outputs used
prediction_rule: score==1.0 -> entailed;score<1 -> not_entailed, frozen before execution
failure_rule: Stop group on first failure; preserve failed and not-run rows, no budget reset
inputs: Only premise/hypothesis/question; reference label excluded from all model input
date_scope: Separate general-text reference task, as_of is captured dataset observation time. No company historical facts or240cohort inputs. Project company cutoff unchanged.
limits: Three hypotheses share one premise; not independent broad sample
Public widely-used dataset may be in model training; no unseen-holdout claim
General caption entailment does not establish diligence performance
Captured unversioned rows hashed, repository revision correspondence not authenticated
